label: Matthew Henry, Complete Commentary on the Whole Bible
licenseRecord: The WORK is public domain by age (Matthew Henry, 1662-1714; commentary published 1706-1721). The TRANSCRIPTION is CCEL's: CrossWire distributes this module as DistributionLicense=Public Domain with TextSource=http://www.ccel.org/, and its About field states 'Public Domain--Copy Freely'. CCEL nonetheless asks permission for commercial republication of their own files, which is why treasury-of-david-* deliberately avoided them. ADMITTED HERE ON A NARROWER READING, decided by Jesse 2026-07-29: this artifact redistributes a term-statistics distillate — term, PMI, occurrence count and provenance — never the prose. Nothing a reader could reconstruct the transcription from is shipped, so the distillate is not republication of CCEL's files. Recorded in full rather than flattened to 'public_domain' so the judgment is auditable and so the difference from the Treasury decision is visible rather than looking like an inconsistency.
attributionNote: Second whole-Bible expositor, and therefore the source that first makes corroboration possible outside the Psalter. Written by SECTION, not by verse: the module stores one essay against every verse it covers, and the importer collapses those runs so the recorded span is the section Henry actually wrote about.
